instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page React application for Nirman Project Group using react-router-dom.
Implement English and Hindi language toggle with state management so text seamlessly switches between English and Hindi.
Include management team cards: GM Ashif Ali, Manager Soeb Aktar, and Operations Manager Nausad (Rajan).
Ensure client logos and government project stats are labeled with clear verification/placeholder badges per user requirements (NO fake claims).
All buttons, inputs, tabs, and links MUST include unique data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide icons (HardHat, Zap, Building2, Truck, Wrench, ShieldCheck, Phone, Mail, Globe, CheckCircle2, FileText, Users) extensively.
Integrate Sonner for form toast notifications (quote requests, career applications, contact form submission).
Include a floating WhatsApp direct action button fixed at the bottom right of the screen.
